svg.title: Bag Holders box banner
svg.desc: A long plum pegboard with twelve kinds of bag on steel hooks, six on each side of BAG HOLDERS in big cream letters. A tote, a bean bag, a sleeping bag, a paper bag, a punching bag and a tea bag hang on the left. A duffel bag, a bag of chips, a gift bag, a backpack, a bag of lemons and a sandbag hang on the right.
